findings.title: Timed-out releases can outlive their claims and invalidate a subsequent seal
findings.detail: PARTIALLY_FIXED. The new claims and claimant-specific recording at packages/persistence/src/source/holds.ts:203 and :240 prevent the previously tested overlapping live retries. However, boundedProviderCall only races the existing provider promise against a timer; it neither cancels nor fences the provider effect. apps/control/src/storage-work.ts:104 uses this wrapper for releaseHold. Once an unanswered claim's 910-second in-flight bound passes, holds.ts:143 and :157 ignore it, allowing a new hold after another retry records RELEASED. The old provider call can still execute: packages/application/src/testing/contract-fake-object-storage.ts:832 waits before applying the effect, and :533 clears the generation's current hold without an incarnation check. A read-only probe confirmed TIMEOUT, pending release, successful retry, new HELD, delayed RELEASED, and successful overwrite. Post-commit reassertion does not prevent the invalid seal: seal-revision.ts:351 and :505 record the observation while returning the committed result. apps/control/test/seal-holds.test.ts:488 explicitly tests replacement before commit followed by a 200 at :502 and later inventory revocation. The passing retry regression at :238 (verify.log:658) resumes the delayed call while its claim is live; it does not cover a call surviving its in-flight bound. The full expired-claim database interleaving was established by code inspection, not executed.
findings.reproduction: Fail a seal before commit and pause its cleanup release with storage.holdNext('releaseHold'). Let boundedProviderCall return TIMEOUT while the underlying release remains pending. Advance the application/control test clocks beyond that claim's 910-second in-flight bound. Run a release retry to completion and record RELEASED. Start SealRevision and pause at journal.commit after its new provider hold. Resume the original timed-out release, overwrite the accepted object, then resume the seal. The old release clears the new hold; the seal commits and returns 200, recording GENERATION_NOT_LIVE for later inventory revocation. The database's admission after the expired bound is explicitly asserted at packages/persistence/test/source-adapters.test.ts:1973.

findings.title: Per-association counts remain preserved through evaluation and sealing
findings.detail: FIXED. tablesWithAssociations validates and attaches measured association counts; lines 120 and 144 persist and hash them. packages/application/src/sources/handlers/seal-revision.ts:529 validates the measured split when constructing the sealed subject. The integrated regression at apps/control/test/end-to-end.test.ts:199 checks independently calculated persisted and sealed counts at lines 260–264. verify.log:642 records its pass.
findings.reproduction: A two-association selection passes through SelectInputTables, the real evaluation consumer and SealRevision, preserving distinct WORKS_AT and OWNED_BY counts and their sum.

findings.title: Excluded hidden columns remain excluded from projection counts
findings.detail: FIXED. Only counted cells enter the projection lookup; lines 215–217 reject projection references to excluded hidden columns. packages/data-plane/test/selection-evaluation.test.ts:371 retains hidden-key, hidden-field, formula-policy and visible-column controls. verify.log:618 records its pass.
findings.reproduction: Projecting an excluded hidden column fails PROJECTION_COLUMN_HIDDEN. Including it applies the formula policy, while the visible-column positive control succeeds.

findings.title: Lapsed unresolved cancellation secrets remain discoverable and purged
findings.detail: FIXED. Agency-paged discovery finds lapsed cancellation secrets and invokes cleanup at line 66. apps/control/src/storage-work.ts:222–224 purges the secret after its horizon without claiming cancellation confirmation or calling the provider. apps/control/test/storage-lifecycle.test.ts:295 checks retained UNCERTAIN status, secret removal, no additional provider call and pagination past cleaned agencies. verify.log:669 records its pass.
findings.reproduction: An unresolved cancellation retains its secret before expiry, loses it on the post-horizon sweep, and does not prevent discovery of a later agency's remaining secret.
